lines.style: Speak English as a cheerful Japanese learner greeting a friend on New Year's morning, bright and warm. Say every word exactly as written: 'Ear' is the body part and starts directly on the vowel, like Japanese 'iyaa', with NO 'y' sound before it, so a listener clearly hears 'Happy New Ear!' Slightly flat, syllable-by-syllable Japanese-style timing. Natural, not a caricature.
